script: Some rays can zap their prey with electricity. Electric rays make shocks with special organs that work like batteries. The Atlantic torpedo ray can produce around 200 volts. That is enough to stun a fish, and painful for a person. Ancient Roman doctors wrote about using these rays to treat headaches. The word torpedo comes from the Latin name for this fish, meaning numbness. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
